d:
Get ready to be mesmerized by the beautiful and heart-touching Mahanati Full Video Song from the movie Mahanati ! Starring Keerthy Suresh and Dulquer Salmaan, this soul-stirring song will leave you speechless. Beautifully composed by Mickey J Meyer and the soulful vocals by Anurag Kulkarni.
Song Name : Mahanati
Movie: Mahanati
Production: Vyjayanthi Movies
Producers: Aswani Dutt, Priyanka Dutt and Swapna Dutt
Director: Nag Ashwin
Cast : Keerthy Suresh, Dulquer Salmaan, Vijay Devarakonda, Samantha Akkineni and Others.
Music : Mickey J Meyer
